subject: Re: ClearHarbor VPC commercial questions — platform fee split & SLA fallback
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearharbor.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearharbor.io
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial clarification: platform fee allocation for VPC deployment

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's performance profile. Before we move to signature we have a couple of commercial clarifications from procurement. We want to understand how the platform fee is treated across a multi-site VPC deployment: specifically:

- Is the platform fee per-customer (one flat platform fee regardless of node count) or per-site?
- If we add additional on-prem sites after year one, how are platform fees and support tiers amortized?
- Are there any introductory discounts or credits for phased rollouts?

Also, can you include a short note on the SLA fallback if dedicated capacity in our region is constrained (we need an ops fallback that guarantees <200ms p95 or automatic routing to an alternate compatible variant)? Procurement wants that in the SOW.

We have budget planning next week so a quick confirmation would help. Attaching our internal procurement checklist separately.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Procurement, ClearHarbor
[Attachment: CH_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearharbor.io>, procurement@clearharbor.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial clarification: platform fee allocation for VPC deployment

Thanks Alex — appreciate the clear list of asks. Quick answers below and I attached an initial SOW + pricing grid.

- Platform fee: Customer-level license (one platform fee) that covers control plane and orchestration features across sites. Nodes are licensed separately (seat/node pricing in the attached vpc_pricing_grid.xlsx).
- Adding sites: Platform fee is not re-billed when you add additional on-prem sites within the initial contract term. New sites incur node licenses and a one-time onboarding retainer if engineering needs to provision dedicated connectors. We include a 12-month amortization option on onboarding retainer to help CAPEX planning.
- Introductory credits: We can offer a phased-rollout credit — 10% credit on platform fee for the first 6 months when signing within 30 days of the proposal. This is standard for our VPC pilots.
- SLA fallback: We include an automatic routing policy in the SOW: if local dedicated capacity p95 exceeds 200ms for 10 consecutive minutes, requests will overflow to the regional-resident compatible variant (same model family, quantized) and we provide a degraded-latency SLA (p95 < 350ms) with an incident ticket and crediting mechanism if that fallback persists. Full escalation path in the SOW appendix.

Next steps: if that covers it I can update the SOW to explicitly call out the amortization language and DocuSign-ready signature page.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CH_ClearHarbor_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearharbor.io>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial clarification: platform fee allocation for VPC deployment

Looping in ops and commercial nuance — a few clarifications we should include before sending final SOW to procurement: 

- Define "compatible variant" for fallback: specify acceptable differences (quantization level, exact model name allowed to differ by minor revision). We should avoid unintentionally promising identical semantics.
- Credit mechanics: propose credit = pro-rata platform fee for each full day the fallback persists beyond the 4-hour remediation window, capped at 30% of monthly platform fee.
- Onboarding retainer amortization: confirm amortization schedule (12 months or term length, whichever is shorter) and whether finance needs to treat it as CAPEX vs OPEX.

Also — given ClearHarbor's expected 3-site rollout and 24/7 support requirement, can we approve a 10% one-time onboarding credit plus a 7.5% platform fee promotional discount (instead of full 10% ongoing credit) to make the math cleaner for procurement? If approved, I recommend a clear audit clause limiting the credit to pilot usage.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Director, Customer Success

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearharbor.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearharbor.io
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 07:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial clarification: platform fee allocation for VPC deployment

Thanks Irene / Ben — that helps a lot. A couple of follow-ups from finance: 

1) If we take the 10% onboarding credit + 7.5% platform fee promo, can we get the credits reflected as line-item credits on the invoice rather than a post-facto rebate? Finance prefers credits applied at invoice time for auditability.
2) For amortization: we need the onboarding retainer amortized over 24 months (our CAPEX schedule). Are you able to accommodate 24 months instead of 12?

Assuming those two things are OK we'll fast-track the internal approvals. Also — happy to sign an NDA addendum to enable deeper architecture review for the multi-site topology.

Best,
Alex

[Procurement note: prefer invoice credits; will accept DocuSign flow if credits are clearly visible.]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearharbor.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial clarification: platform fee allocation for VPC deployment

Alex — good questions. We can do both items with minor contract language tweaks: 

1) Invoice credits: commercial team will show the onboarding credit and platform fee promotional discount as line-item credits on the first two invoices (pilot month + month 2) for auditability. Our billing team can emit a separate credit memo referencing the HubSpot deal id.
2) Amortization: legal/finance are OK with a 24-month amortization for the onboarding retainer for this customer. We'll add explicit language that amortization schedule is 24 months for CH-2027-005.

Ben — approved concession: 10% onboarding credit (one-time) + 7.5% platform fee promotional discount applied for the first 6 months appears reasonable. I will include the fallback credit mechanics Ben proposed in the SOW appendix.

I'll prepare a DocuSign packet with the updated SOW and the invoice-credit language and send by Monday. Please confirm if we should also add the NDA addendum to the same envelope.

Thanks,
Irene

---
Irene Choi
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearharbor.io>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jan 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClearHarbor VPC commercial questions — platform fee split & SLA fallback (Final SOW ready)

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. We bundled everything into a single DocuSign envelope: SOW v1 (with Appendix A: SLA fallback & credits), invoice credit schedule, and the NDA addendum. Key callouts in the packet: 

- One platform fee per customer; node licenses billed per-site.
- One-time onboarding retainer (amortized over 24 months).
- Concession: 10% onboarding credit (applied as invoice line item) + 7.5% platform fee promotional discount (applied to invoices for months 1–6).
- Fallback credit: pro-rata daily credit after 4-hour remediation window, capped at 30% of monthly platform fee.
- DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/CH-2027-005-sign

Please sign when ready and I'll route countersignature once we receive. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if procurement wants to run the invoice flow with our billing ops.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise Contracts Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vpc_pricing_grid.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]
